caption: Sometimes I notice my body reacts differently to late-night snacks. What about you? 🍿
comments_seeded: I often wonder if our bodies can tell when we're eating out of boredom or actual hunger
It's interesting how some foods seem to affect our energy levels more than others, even if they're not necessarily 'unhealthy'
Do you find yourself reaching for certain snacks when you're stressed or tired, and do you think that affects how your body reacts to them?
I've noticed that paying attention to my body's reactions to different foods can be really helpful in figuring out what works best for me
